title: Five Palaces, One Model: Testing Google’s Gemini 4 Hydrogen in AI Studio
why_read: A fun but shallow demo write-up showcasing a new Gemini model's generative coding capability rather than offering deep technical insight.
analysis: This post describes a personal project built using a newly released fast-tier Gemini model to generate an interactive 3D scene of Japanese palaces, including lighting effects and procedurally generated audio. It functions mainly as a show-and-tell for the model's one-shot creative coding ability rather than an in-depth technical breakdown of how it works. The specs mentioned, like the 1M-token context and pricing, are useful data points, but overall this reads more like a product demo blog than substantive engineering content.
